title: The Princess and the Goblin
description: Princess Irene discovers a mysterious great-great-grandmother in a hidden tower while the miner boy Curdie uncovers a goblin plot beneath the mountain.
catalogueBlurb: A hidden tower, a silver thread and goblins beneath the mountain.
author: George MacDonald, retold by Quill

text.source: Original Story House retelling based on George MacDonald's public-domain 1872 novel
text.notes: The underlying 1872 novel is public domain. This wording is an original child-friendly Unicorn Valley retelling.

illustrations.source: Jessie Willcox Smith illustrations from the 1920 David McKay edition
illustrations.notes: The illustrated 1920 edition is available through Project Gutenberg. Jessie Willcox Smith died in 1935, so her artwork is also out of copyright in the UK.

rights.curatorNotes: Twelve reader sections preserve Irene, Curdie, the mysterious grandmother, the silver thread, the goblin plot and the flooding of the underground kingdom while making the Victorian prose more accessible.
